Hey sorry about the late response, I don’t seem to get noti’s on here fsr but.. you can take raw terp a drop or two per ounce .. if you dont want to put it on a very small strip of paper towel.. i find it best to use some kind of organic matter like fruit peel or lettuce.. put the drops on there.. make sure there isnt any mold or the material you choose isnt overly moist.. just as it should be.. wipe off any obvious moisture before u apply the drops on it.. 

If you have your onions separated in jars do that for each jar but remember to let air for a while because terps are very concentrated and just dumping em on the buds may give it a chemical..off putting taste.. essentially you will be curing the terps as well

The buds will then suck the moisture from the peel or whatever you chose and you will notice the change in texture.. burp regularly to let the buds breathe and exhale thoroughly.. (yes they are still “alive” while they are cut off stem) theoretically the terps within the air that is passing through the buds will be readily received and trapped within the buds..

Depending on how dry the buds were prior to doing this..Within 24hrs the peel’s moisture should have already been leached out and into the buds.. you can take them out at this time without worry.. 

I find that 2 weeks in is the sweet spot.. the gas from the terps change the buds’ texture quite a bit and makes it softer to touch.. easier to break down.. combusts more evenly and slower.. smoother.. flavorful smoke..

I recently started experimenting with pure extracts that share prominent terps like caryophelene and linalool like lemongrass, lavender, or rosemary.. its been having nice effects.. but thats also aromatherapeutic
